meta.description: Learn about the mission, vision and institutional values of the Universidad Nacional de Concepción, guiding its academic work and social commitment.

hero.label: Institutional identity
hero.title: Mission, Vision & Values
hero.description: The principles guiding the academic and institutional work of the Universidad Nacional de Concepción

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Our reason for being
mission.body: To train well-rounded professionals with solid scientific and technical knowledge, committed to the sustainable development of northern Paraguay and the well-being of society.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: Where we are headed
vision.body: To be a university of excellence, a benchmark in research, innovation and university outreach, recognized nationally and internationally for the quality of its academic processes.

values.title: Our values
values.description: The institutional values that guide the conduct of the entire university community.

v1.name: Excellence
v1.description: Permanent pursuit of quality in all academic, administrative and institutional processes.

v2.name: Integrity
v2.description: Ethical and transparent conduct in all dimensions of university life.

v3.name: Innovation
v3.description: Promotion of creativity, research and the adoption of new knowledge and technologies.

v4.name: Inclusion
v4.description: Guaranteed access to higher education regardless of origin, social or economic status.

v5.name: Social commitment
v5.description: Active responsibility for the human, economic and cultural development of the regional community.

v6.name: Responsibility
v6.description: Rigorous fulfillment of institutional commitments to students, the State and society.

cta.title: Discover our history and structure
cta.description: Explore the institutional foundations of the Universidad Nacional de Concepción.
